description: This file is a Go source code module for parsing kernel slab memory information from /proc/slabinfo, including data structures, parsing functions, and logic to handle different slabinfo versions.

classes.name: Slab
classes.description: Represents a kernel slab pool with various memory and tunable parameters.

classes.name: SlabInfo
classes.description: Contains a list of Slab objects representing all slabs.

methods.name: shouldParseSlab
methods.description: Determines if a line from /proc/slabinfo should be parsed based on version and header.

methods.name: parseV21SlabEntry
methods.description: Parses a line from /proc/slabinfo version 2.1 into a Slab object.

methods.name: parseSlabInfo21
methods.description: Parses the entire /proc/slabinfo file content into a SlabInfo structure.

methods.name: SlabInfo
methods.description: Reads and parses slab info data from /proc/slabinfo.
